changelog:
🎯 DIKA REJOIN SUITE PRO v1.3.8 (DETEKSI AKUN <13 PRESENCE & MULTI-LAYER IN-GAME VERIFIER)

1. Deteksi Mutlak Akun <13 (Age Group 9-12):
   - Berdasarkan menu PrivateServerPrivacy: Jika opsi 'Everyone' tidak ada / ditolak Roblox (hanya ada 'Friends'), akun mutlak dikategorikan sebagai <13.
   - Otomatis masuk antrean Add Friend & Auto-Accept agar Main tidak terkena Error 524.

2. Multi-Layer Live Presence Verification (Anti-Ghosting 100% Akurat):
   - Layer 1: Health Ping Sesi Bot Langsung (skip jika cookie 401 / logout).
   - Layer 2: Real-time Presence Type Check (userPresenceType == 2).
   - Layer 3: Place ID Verification (mencegah nyasar di game berbeda).
   - Layer 4: Job ID & Debounce Double-Sample (anti-ghosting / anti-stuck di loading screen).
